name: Go notes service
description: A Go HTTP service with SQL built by formatting, a shell command, MD5, math/rand tokens, a path read, reflected output, disabled TLS verification and a hard-coded token. Intentionally insecure, for education.
expected: Findings from the Go token scanner.

fixes.title: Read the admin token from the environment
fixes.explanation: The token is no longer in the repository (rotate the exposed value).

fixes.title: Use a placeholder for the search term
fixes.explanation: The term is passed as a query argument instead of being formatted into the SQL text.
edits:
q := fmt.Sprintf("SELECT id, title FROM notes WHERE title LIKE '%%%s%%'", term)
	rows, _ := db.Query(q)
rows, _ := db.Query("SELECT id, title FROM notes WHERE title LIKE $1", "%"+term+"%")

fixes.title: Run ls with a fixed argument list
fixes.explanation: No shell parses the directory name; it is a single argument to a fixed program.

fixes.title: Use SHA-256 instead of MD5
fixes.explanation: MD5 is broken for security use. (A real password store should use argon2 or bcrypt.)

fixes.title: Draw the session token from crypto/rand
fixes.explanation: crypto/rand is a cryptographically secure source; math/rand is predictable.

fixes.title: Confine downloads to the notes directory
fixes.explanation: Only the base name is used, so '../' cannot leave the directory.

fixes.title: Escape the name before writing it
fixes.explanation: html.EscapeString turns markup into harmless text.
